description: Wreckage in situ: a large section of a B-52 shot down over Hanoi on the night of 27 December 1972 lies half-submerged in Huu Tiep lake where it fell. It is a national historic relic; the lake and its surroundings were restored in 2021-2022 and reopened to visitors for the 50th anniversary of the Dien Bien Phu in the Air campaign. Sources differ on the model (B-52D/G) and no serial is recorded.
aliases: B52; B 52; Ho Huu Tiep; B-52 lake
